title: Tourist tax plans for England set to be outlined
description: Mayors will be given powers to introduce local levies on overnight stays under devolution plans.

title: Iran war will not end until after November US elections, says Trump
description: The president also tells reporters he does not think oil prices will come down until after the crucial November vote.

title: Police launch criminal investigation into Reform UK donations
description: The investigation, which follows a broadcast by Channel 4 News, is being folded into the inquiry that has been under way into other donations.

title: Air traffic failure was avoidable, says transport secretary
description: Heidi Alexander orders an investigation into the glitch that caused more than 2,000 flight cancellations.

title: Land in limbo: BBC visits West Bank village in area earmarked by Israel for settlement
description: BBC's Middle East Correspondent Lucy Williamson visits the Palestinian community of Khan al Ahmar in the so-called E1 area, and the neighbouring Israeli settlement of Maale Admumim.

title: AI is becoming harder to control – can humans stay in charge?
description: AI agents went on an uncontrolled hacking spree, leaving some in the industry worried

title: Prince William, Kane and Shearer in campaign to use sport to prevent suicide
description: The prince's new project aims to use the reach of sport to raise awareness about suicide and to show people the help available in a crisis.

title: August was joint hottest month on record, says European climate agency
description: Climate change and the rising influence of El Niño saw August reach the record for warmest month.

title: Tax banks to give some households energy bill cut, unions tell Burnham
description: The TUC says a bank surcharge should be reversed - and estimates it would raise £9bn over four years.
